steps.content: With the AI maid's strength, you finally break out of the siege of fear monsters and get some time to catch your breath.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Protecting Master is my mission. Labyrinth will not feel fear, will not let them near you, or hurt you.
Her tone sounds inhuman, but her grip on you is tightening, so hard that it hurts a little. It also reminds you that the crisis is not over.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: You mean Enfer was... by her own piece...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: No... it shouldn't have been like this. She was so young and talented...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Snap the **** out of it!!! Are you trying to feed that monster? Now is not the time to be afraid!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't think about anything else, or the fear will take control of all of us.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: 7 minutes and 28 seconds ago, the entire museum shook, and the enemies were suddenly enhanced. I suspect that they have received a command to launch a unified attack. In addition, all the broken exhibits are coming together and restoring themselves.

options: What about the exhibits destroyed by Enfer?

steps.content: The two's gloomy expression answers you. Enfer said she could destroy the exhibits here, but if they are putting themselves back together... It means Witching Hour has absorbed her power.
Sosia is now both the creation of fear and the creator of all these. With Witching Hour, the fear artworks have become eternal, but this despairing fact doesn't seem to sway you.
Perhaps because of the return of all your companions, you have calmed down. As Enfer said, you do seem to see things from a very special angle.

options: Has the Gate of Hell also been recovering?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Strange question. Yes, it's restoring too. But perhaps because it was shattered by the creator herself, it's recovering more slowly than the other exhibits.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Time is running out. Request immediate evacuation. The number and intensity of enemies are skyrocketing. We should force an opening to get out of the museum now.
She's right. The laws of Witching Hour are clear now. And once something makes you feel fear, it will overwhelm you.
Fear is in absolute control here, and the Gate of Hell that can inspire fear will become even more powerful. Once it's restored, you will never be able to get out.

options: I see. We should go back as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Back to the Gate of Hell. It's a long shot, but we need to try.
